meta.title: Contact and visitation chronology — recorded NRE and dates to review
meta.description: First-weekend inventory since 2017, with 2026 dates requiring review and a live separation clock that does not fabricate actual contact hours.

reference.heading: Complaint reference
reference.prefix: Complaint for failure to present a child under French Criminal Code
reference.filed: Filed on 4 September 2023 in Nanterre with the Prosecutor, Court of Valence (TGI Valence).
reference.judgment: The list starts from the enforceable judgment of 31 March 2017. Facts are not reproduced here; the official document remains the source.

note.heading: Note
note.p1: It is said that we are born equal, but we certainly do not give birth equally. The mother has every right to choose where to give birth, without the father’s consent.
note.p2: She knows that whatever she does, she will have sole parental authority, exclusive custody, and the possibility to manipulate the child and use them to obtain rights, power, and money—without ever being held to account.
note.p3: I advise any father against involving social services and filing a complaint against a violent and abusive mother. The result will be that you will never be able to protect your child and they will grow up without you.

timeline.heading: Timeline by year
timeline.lead: Each year shows first weekends of the month. ✗ = recorded historical NRE claim, ✓ = honored or partial, ? = unverified date. Later dates are not automatically criminal findings.

location.heading: Location
location.body: 2015 France; since 2017 Norway, Oslo; since 2022 Germany, Frankfurt.

table.heading: First weekends of each month
table.lead: Historic inventory is published through February 2026. From March 2026, dates are generated automatically but their status requires checking the reported German court decision.

exceptions.heading: Reported honored or partial visits
exceptions.lead: Six historic entries indicate honored or partial visits. The actual duration together is not verified.
exceptions.genericDetail: Contact reported as honored or partial — actual duration unverified.

hours.heading: Contact hours: known and unknown
hours.nominal: Nominal hours for archived NRE entries (10 h / weekend)
hours.net: Elapsed time less manually recorded actual contact hours
hours.actual: Hours actually spent together (optional local input)
hours.actualHint: Enter only substantiated hours actually spent together. Nothing is presumed, stored or transmitted. The value clears on reload.
hours.scope: This live clock measures calendar time from an approximate date-only reference (UTC start of day; actual start time unknown). It is neither a court-verified NRE total nor proof of missed legal contact hours.
hours.source: Nominal hours apply an owner-reported 10 h first-weekend schedule only to historical rows marked NRE after the 31 March 2017 decision. Actual contact hours cannot be recovered from exception labels.
hours.refresh: The timer updates each second. The month inventory is recalculated from the local Paris date.
hours.suspension: A German contact suspension was reported from 26 February 2026 through 25 February 2027; the operative court order has not been verified here. Later dates are not labeled NRE.
hours.beforeOrder: The March 2017 row predates the cited 31 March 2017 decision and needs review.
hours.intro: Nominal missed visiting hours must not be confused with elapsed separation time.
hours.nominalHint: Estimate based on archived NRE entries only; not a judicial finding or verified time together.
hours.netHint: Cannot be established without reliable actual contact hours.
hours.contactEstimate: Indicative hours based on reported contact weekends
hours.contactEstimateHint: Nominal reference: five periods with no reported interruption, at 10 h each. These are not verified hours spent together.
